description:
PROJECT NUMBER:  UT NP ARCH 100(2) 

  PROJECT NAME:  Bridges on Delicate Arch Road 

  PROJECT DESCRIPTION:   

 Delicate Arch Road (DAR) is within Arches National Park (Park) and provides access to Delicate Arch. DAR is a functional class 1 roadway (Principal Park Road) and is heavily traveled by visitors and often congested during periods with moderate-to-high levels of visitation. 

 DAR crosses three low-gradient ephemeral washes (Salt Valley Wash, Salt Wash, and Winter Camp Wash) near their confluence in the Salt Wash Basin downstream of Wolfe Ranch. Culverts installed during original road construction in the mid-1990s and during subsequent upgrades are inadequate to allow unobstructed stream flow and sediment transport downstream. This existing condition produces flooding and sediment deposition, which creates unsafe conditions for visitors, triggers road closures, potentially strands Park visitors, diminishes visitor experience of the Park, and generates high operational costs associated with traffic management, visitor safety, and cleanup operations. 

  SCOPE OF THE WORK:   

 This project will be designated as Reconstruction (4R) with one segment of restoration (3R), and will design and construct 100’ span concrete bridges at the Salt Valley Wash, Salt Wash, and Winter Camp Wash. The DA roadway profile at each Wash will be raised to accommodate a 10-year design frequency and allow a medium-sized excavator to access each wash. The DA will be realigned at the Salt Valley wash, moving the roadway and new bridge location to the north of the existing roadway and drainage crossing. The remaining 3R sections of the roadway will receive full depth reclamation (FDR) or removal of pavement, including all parking areas, followed by a 4-inch pavement overlay.  

  PRINCIPAL WORK ITEMS:  

 
	 20420-0000 Embankment Construction: 10,000 CUYD 
	 25101-0300 Placed Riprap, Class 3: 1,725 CUYD 
	 30202-2000 Roadway Aggregate, Method 2: 5,140 TON 
	 40101-5600 Asphalt Concrete Pavement, Gyratory Mix, 1/2-Inch or 3/4-Inch Nominal Maximum Size Aggregate, 0.3 To <3 Million ESAL: 8,300 TON 
	 55201-0200 Structural Concrete, Class A (AE): 752 CUYD 
	 55401-2000 Reinforcing Steel, Epoxy Coated: 138,000 LB 
	 55601-1100 Bridge Railing, Steel, Two Rail: 642 LNFT 
	 56501-0200 Drilled Shaft, 24-Inch Diameter: 750 LNFT 
	 56501-0300 Drilled Shaft, 30-Inch Diameter: 890 LNFT 
	 60901-1300 Curb, Concrete, 15-Inch Depth (Reinforced, Colored): 3,921 LNFT 
	 61701-4500 Guardrail System Mgs, Type 2, Class A Steel Posts: 1,290 LNFT 
	 63506-0500 Temporary Traffic Control, Flagger: 5,800 HOUR 
 

  ANTICIPATED SCHEDULE:   

 Advertisement – September 2026 

 Award – November 2026 

 NTP – December 2026 

 Contract Completion – December 2028 

  ESTIMATED COST RANGE:   

 Total estimated cost between $10,000,000 and $20,000,000 

 This will be solicited as a full and open competition.
